fields.meta_title: Free Audition Form Builder for Casting Calls | Emergent
fields.meta_description: Build an audition form that counts rehearsal conflicts for each actor and turns judge scores into a callback list. Free to start.
fields.h1: Build an Audition Form for Every Role You Cast
fields.hero_description: Build an audition form that books each performer into an open slot and saves their headshot and conflicts to your database.
fields.features_heading: What the Panel Gets From the Form
fields.features_subheading: Emergent builds an audition form around the roles and rehearsal dates you list, and every sign-up lands as a row the panel can score.
fields.feature_1:
Questions that change with the role

An actor who picks Ensemble skips the sides. A singer who picks a lead is asked for vocal range and the title of a 32-bar song cut. Each person answers only what the role needs.
fields.feature_2:
Headshots and resumes on every record

Each performer uploads a headshot and a resume with the form. The panel opens both files from each sign-up, and they stay on that person's row in a database you own.
fields.feature_3:
Rehearsal dates as checkboxes

List the actual rehearsal and performance dates, and performers tick the ones they cannot make. Conflicts come in as dates the app counts per person, not a paragraph of notes.
fields.feature_4:
An email after sign-up and after casting

The app emails each performer a confirmation with their audition time once they submit. When casting is done, it emails each callback or decision to one person by name.
fields.feature_5:
One scoring sheet for the whole panel

Judges score each audition on their own screens against the criteria you set, such as pitch and stage presence. The app averages the panel's scores and ranks every performer.
fields.feature_6:
The code goes with the production

Export the full code of the audition form and its database to your GitHub repository on paid plans. A developer can then reuse it for next season's auditions or a second venue.

fields.usecase_heading: Audition Forms for Four Kinds of Production
fields.tab_content_1:
Four conflicts or more and the director sees it

Ostrowe Street Players is casting its spring musical. Every actor ticks the rehearsal dates they cannot make, and the form counts them. Owen Gallagher, reading for a lead, marks five. Anyone with four conflicts or more goes on the director's review list before callbacks are sent.
fields.tab_content_2:
No slot gets booked twice in a 5-minute schedule

Linden Bluff High's drama club holds fall play auditions in 5-minute slots after school on Tuesday. Each student books one slot from a phone, and a taken time drops off the list for everyone else. Jonah Abernathy books 3:35 pm, and the confirmation goes to him and to the parent email on his form.
fields.tab_content_3:
With three judges, the average decides the callback

Kestrel Valley Youth Orchestra takes recorded auditions, and the panel never sees a name. Three judges score each recording from 1 to 10 under an audition number. The app averages the scores, and any player at 8 or higher goes on the callback list. Audition #104, a violin player, averages 8.7.
fields.tab_content_4:
Self-tapes come in by role, and one becomes a callback

Paper Kite Films posted a casting call for a short film with two speaking roles. Each actor picks a role and pastes a link to a self-tape, and the board groups the tapes by role. The casting director picks Priya Natarajan to play Hollis, and the app emails Priya a callback for Saturday at 10:00 am with scene 12 to prepare.

fields.howto_title: How to Make an Audition Form
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to turn your roles and rehearsal calendar into an audition form that books slots and builds a callback list.
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Decide which files to ask for
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Set the audition day and slot length
fields.howto_step_1_des: Write down every role you are casting and what each one asks of a performer: a song, a monologue, a dance combination, or a cold read. Note which roles share scenes, because those actors may need to read together at callbacks.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Collect every rehearsal and performance date before you build. Then decide how many missed dates you can work around for a lead and for the ensemble. That number becomes the flag the director sees on each sign-up.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Ask for a headshot and a resume for acting roles, and a link to a recording when people audition remotely. Leave out any file the panel will not open. Every extra upload is another step for someone filling in the form on a phone.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Choose the day and the slot length, such as 5 minutes per singer. Leave a 10-minute gap every hour for the panel to catch up. Decide now whether a performer may book more than one slot.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Write one prompt that holds the decisions from the first four steps. Emergent builds the form and its database, along with a scoring screen for the panel. Change anything later by prompting again, such as adding a vocal range question.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Test it with two past performers
fields.howto_step_6_des: Send the link to two people from last season before it goes public. Ask one to book a slot from a phone and the other to upload a headshot and tick a few conflicts. Check that both entries land on the right record.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Publish the call and score in one place
fields.howto_step_7_des: Publish the form and put its link in the audition notice. Close it at the deadline you announced. Judges then score each audition on the same records the sign-ups created, and callbacks go out from there.

faq_plan.a: An audition form is what a performer fills in before trying out for a part. Merriam-Webster defines an audition as a trial performance to appraise an entertainer's merits. The form tells the panel who is performing, which roles they want, and which rehearsal dates they cannot make.

faq_plan.q: How to make an audition form?
faq_plan.ref: How to make an audition form?

prov.original: How to make an audition form?

faq_plan.a: Write down the parts you are filling and every rehearsal date, then describe them in one prompt to Emergent's AI form builder. It builds the form with its time slots, plus a database of every sign-up. Send the link to two past performers as a test before you post the casting notice.

faq_plan.q: What should an audition form template include?
faq_plan.a: Start with contact details, the roles a performer wants, past experience, and every rehearsal date they cannot make. Add a headshot and resume upload for acting roles and a vocal range question for singers. If you begin from an audition form pdf, carry its questions into your prompt and leave its layout behind.

faq_plan.q: Can an audition form close automatically at the deadline?
faq_plan.a: Yes, if you build it that way. Tell Emergent the closing date and time, and the form stops taking sign-ups at that moment and shows a closed message instead. A giveaway landing page uses the same kind of cutoff, where entries stop at a set time.

faq_plan.q: How do I let performers book time slots on an audition form?
faq_plan.a: Enter when the first slot starts and how long each one runs, and the form offers each performer only the times still open. Add a waitlist as well. Once the last slot goes, later sign-ups join the waitlist and get an email when a time frees up.

faq_plan.q: How do I collect self-tapes with an audition form?
faq_plan.a: Ask for a link to the self-tape and the role it is for, and have the field accept only a web address. A link keeps the form quick to fill in on a phone, and the video stays wherever the actor posted it. The panel opens each tape from the sign-up list.

faq_plan.q: Should an audition form ask for a headshot and resume?
faq_plan.a: For acting roles, yes. Ask for both as uploads and store them on the performer's record, the way a rental application form keeps pay stubs with each application. For an orchestra or choir, ask for a recording link instead, since the panel judges the sound.

faq_plan.q: How do I send callbacks from audition form responses?
faq_plan.a: Mark each performer as a callback on the response list, and the app emails every callback the time and the scene to prepare. Performers who are not called back can get a separate, kinder note the same day. Emergent builds both emails from your prompt.

faq_plan.q: How long should audition forms be?
faq_plan.a: Short enough to finish on a phone in about 5 minutes. Put each topic on its own screen, and show the singing and dance questions only to people who pick those roles. Forms Emergent builds have no response caps, even for a large open call.

faq_plan.q: How do judges score auditions from the form?
faq_plan.a: Give every judge the same criteria, such as tone and timing, each scored from 1 to 10 on their own screen. Ask for a one-line note with each score, which helps when two performers tie. The panel's sheet is an assessment form with a fixed rubric, tied to each sign-up.

scope.evidence: H1 'Build an Audition Form for Every Role You Cast'; hero 'Build an audition form that books each performer into an open slot and saves their headshot and conflicts to your database.' covers the whole job.

intent.evidence: SERP is printable theater forms plus Typeform and Jotform templates; page gives what the form should include (FAQ 3), a 7-step build, four production types and a comparison table; PAA 'How to make an audition form?' answered verbatim.

specificity.evidence: Casting vocabulary: '32-bar song cut', 'the sides', 'Audition #104, a violin player, averages 8.7', 'self-tape', 'scene 12 to prepare'.

openers.evidence: Full-sentence openers: 'An actor who picks Ensemble skips the sides.', 'Ostrowe Street Players is casting its spring musical.', 'Write down every role you are casting'.

craft.evidence: Sentences vary and end on the key word ('the director's review list before callbacks are sent'); no tacked-on endings.

voice.evidence: Reads like a stage manager wrote it; no AI-tell vocabulary. Forced link-analogy note ships.

truth.evidence: Emergent sentences map to claims_used (prompt-build, database-owned, alerts 'emails each performer a confirmation', code-export 'on paid plans', no-caps, free-start). FAQ 1 quotes the Merriam-Webster span 'a trial performance to appraise an entertainer's merits' exactly. Averages check: 9,8,9 = 8.7; 7,8,7 = 7.3; 8,9,8 = 8.3; 6,7,7 = 6.7.

distinct.evidence: No contest/raffle sibling topic used; angle is casting work (conflicts, slots, panel scores, callbacks) by production type.

faq.evidence: 10 on-topic questions, secondaries 'audition form template', 'audition forms', 'audition form pdf' carried; hub link item 2; 3 links; paa --spec 10 pass; verbatim Q2 ok.
